name: Carlos Delgado
source:
Ben's classmate in the same mentorship group under Chris, he's one of the three characters Ben has the opportunity to pursue a relationship with over the course of the game. Carlos is the kind who keeps his head down, working hard to eventually become a lawyer.

[Based on [url=https://stormsingerstudios.itch.io/santa-lucia]itch.io[/url]]
